summary: Today I finished reestablishing the concrete production setup, and that's all the old infrastructure that I've taken down rebuilt to be more permanent.

Power management required another escalation. I established a fifth power grid, further isolating major sectors to prevent overload cascades. The system is becoming increasingly segmented, but it’s the only way to maintain stability at this scale.
The new power sector will be using to power Acetylene production and whatever else I work on next.

Acetylene production is now operational. After several days of preparation and expansion, the full chain is finally in place. However, it immediately introduced a new problem — slaked lime byproduct. I don’t yet have a proper way to handle or utilize it, and it’s beginning to accumulate.

I’ve begun setting up lead production at a new deposit to consume the Acetylene as mining fluid. The groundwork is complete, and it should be fully operational by tomorrow. This is a critical step toward solder manufacturing.
I also doubled the steam production at the new water processing sector. This will feed directly into tin extracting that I will setup tomorrow, ensuring both components for solder can be sustained.

Alongside expansion, I spent time on cleanup and base maintenance. I removed the old stone storage from the depleted starter deposit and cleared out soot storage from the original ash processing sector. In parallel, I expanded kerogen and stone storage at the new mining site to better match current throughput.
If everything holds, solder production should come online next. It’s another step toward deeper industrial capability — and likely another layer of logistical strain.

Research was minimal today. I completed Basic Reach 4, extending operational range slightly. Not a major breakthrough, but every incremental improvement continues to reduce friction in daily operations.

status.power: More stable with fifth grid established; sector isolation reducing overload risks.
status.production: Concrete fully operational; acetylene online with unmanaged byproduct; kerogen and stone storage expanded.
status.defense: No major incidents reported; perimeter stable during infrastructure expansion.

todo: Establish tin processing and integrate with steam supply.
